content:
Footer

Configure footer text that appears at the bottom of payments.

Use footers to add terms, conditions, or additional information to payments.

Name

Enter a name to identify this footer. This name will appear in dropdown menus when selecting a footer for payments.

Content

Enter the content that will appear at the bottom of payments. You can include bank information, authorization details, or any other relevant information.

Inactive

Mark this footer as inactive to prevent it from appearing in footer selection dropdowns. Existing payments using this footer will not be affected.
